description: This file defines a template class TimerType within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which implements a timer mechanism with scheduling, triggering, revoking, and processing functionalities. It also includes a nested class TimedInfo for managing scheduled content and a TimerType class for timer management using threads. Additionally, it defines a WatchDogType class for thread-based watchdog timers. The file includes external dependencies on other modules like Module.h, Sync.h, Thread.h, and Time.h.

classes.name: TimerType
classes.description: A template class implementing a scheduled timer with functionalities to schedule, trigger, revoke, and process timed content, utilizing a dedicated thread for timing operations.

classes.name: TimedInfo
classes.description: A helper class within TimerType that encapsulates scheduled content along with its schedule time.

classes.name: TimeWorker
classes.description: A thread class used internally by TimerType to handle timing and execution of scheduled tasks.

classes.name: WatchDogType
classes.description: A thread class implementing a watchdog timer that can be armed, reset, and run a handler upon expiration.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a content item to be triggered at a specific time.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Clears all pending scheduled items and stops the timer thread.

methods.name: HasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific content item is currently scheduled.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers a specific content item immediately, rescheduling if necessary.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Removes a specific content item from the schedule.

methods.name: NextTrigger
methods.description: Returns the time of the next scheduled trigger.

methods.name: Pending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending scheduled items.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the timer thread.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Main processing loop of the timer thread, handling scheduled content execution.
